Thailand, Vietnam, Philippines, Malaysia, Indonesia

If you're in these areas, please stay safe and look out for each other 🩷

Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 11 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Shear Line
Issued at: 11:00 PM, 25 November 2025(Tuesday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Batangas, Laguna, Rizal, Quezon(Pagbilao, Mauban, Atimonan, Padre Burgos, Infanta, General Nakar, Panukulan, Polillo, Burdeos, Patnanungan, Jomalig, Real, Sampaloc, Lucban, Tayabas, Lucena, Sariaya, Tiaong, Dolores, Candelaria, San Antonio) and Bulacan(Norzagaray, Dona Remedios Trinidad).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: Possible FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate rains over Tarlac, Pampanga, Zambales, Bataan and Quezon(Calauag, Quezon, Alabat, Perez, Unisan, Agdangan, Plaridel, Gumaca, Pitogo, Lopez, Tagkawayan, Guinayangan, Macalelon, General Luna, Buenavista, Catanauan, San Francisco, San Narciso, San Andres, Mulanay) within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Metro Manila, Cavite, Bulacan(Angat, Balagtas, Baliuag, Bocaue, Bulakan, Bustos, Calumpit, Malolos, Meycauayan, San Jose del Monte, Guiguinto, Hagonoy, Marilao, Obando, Pandi, Paombong, Plaridel, Pulilan, San Ildefonso, San Miguel, San Rafael, Santa Maria) and Nueva Ecija(Gabaldon, General Tinio) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 2:00 AM tomorrow.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.

🎉 Congratulations to All Outstanding GCV Leaders, Envoys, Ambassadors, and Warriors! 🎉

Prepared by Ms. Lumari, Chairperson and Executive Director, Global GCV Core Team

Today, we proudly salute the extraordinary envoys, ambassadors, generals, and warriors whose unwavering discipline, relentless dedication, and steadfast loyalty to the system set them apart. Your consistent reporting, proactive participation, and timely outputs are not just actions, they are the engine propelling the unstoppable growth of the GCV global ecosystem. You lead by example, and your commitment fuels the success of communities around the world.

🇻🇳 Vietnam – Exemplary Envoys & Ambassadors

Vietnam shines as a beacon of excellence. Your unparalleled teamwork, unwavering discipline, and relentless commitment set the standard for every region within the GCV global community. You don’t just lead  you inspire, uplift, and define what true dedication looks like.

🏅Dao Duc Viet – Vietnam – Chair   
🏅Nguyen Minh Nguyet Education Ambassador – Vietnam  
🏅Vo Thi Dien  Ecosystem Development Ambassador– Vietnam

Vietnam team:
Your leadership and dedication are unmatched. You deliver excellence consistently, inspiring the world to follow your example.

🇹🇭 Thailand – Outstanding Envoys & Ambassadors

Thailand is a powerhouse of energy, output, and action. Your adherence to the system and your discipline make Thailand one of the strongest, most reliable GCV regions globally.  
 
🌱Rung Arun Maneechot – Thailand – Head of GCV Ambassadors
🌱Mr. Phupanthong Chaikhumphu –Ecosystem Development Ambassador Thailand
🌱Banjong Wrongnarong – Education Ambassador, Thailand
🌱Wantana Intrachaeng – Thailand – Chair 
🌱Apiwit Noknakorn – Thailand – Vice Chair   

Thailand team:
Your unity, consistency, and heart-driven leadership inspire everyone across the GCV community. You don’t just meet expectations — you redefine them.

🇨🇳 China – Rising Leadership
China is making remarkable strides in building a disciplined, visionary, and heart-centered GCV ecosystem.  
 
🌱Jian Ping Zhen – China – Chair Envoy
🌱Hong Zhi Wu – China – Vice Chair Envoy 
🌱Shi Long Yu – China – Head of GCV Ambassador  
🌱Chong Kai Sun – China – Education GCV Ambassador

China team:
Your unwavering dedication strengthens the global GCV community and sets a powerful example of leadership, discipline, and relentless excellence. Your commitment to building and advancing the ecosystem inspires all regions to rise higher.

When envoys and ambassadors follow the system with discipline, their community thrives, grows, and achieves extraordinary results.

Even when weekly reporting is the requirement, these leaders deliver daily outputs, proving that commitment is measured by action, not words.

Vietnam, Thailand, and China show the world what 100% dedication looks like. Their actions reflect heart, integrity, and results that elevate the entire GCV ecosystem.

🌐 Global GCV Ambassadors – Worldwide Impact

🌍Mr. Ramesh Shetty – India 
🌍Trinarich Thepprasit – Thailand

These ambassadors lead with vision, integrity, and global impact. Their guidance crosses borders, uplifts communities, and inspires the movement worldwide. 

Special recognition goes to the Top 5 Generals and Warriors who show up daily, report outputs, and consistently exceed expectations:

🏅Mr. Theerawut Jantaman – Thailand 
🏅Ms. Lien Marlina – Indonesia 
🏅Ms. Elshe Afriani – Indonesia 
🏅Mr. Dao Duc Viet – Vietnam 
🏅Ms. Marivic Temblador – Philippines

You are true GCV heroes. Your consistency, heart, and leadership inspire every member of our global community. 

In GCV, leadership is bold, visionary, and relentless. It’s about standing out, thinking differently, and acting courageously when others hesitate.

We don’t wait for permission, we lead because our vision sees farther than anyone else. That vision is what defines a true GCV Warrior.

Most people seek comfort. Most people seek safety.
We are built differently. We push. We challenge limits. We create what others only imagine.

Titles and knowledge alone don’t make leaders. Courage, vision, and the fire to move the movement forward do.

Many will question your passion. Many will test your spirit.

A true GCV Warrior keeps moving even when others stop.

A real leader turns criticism into fuel.

Yesterday may have been heavy, but the mission never sleeps, the spirit never quits, and the hunt for excellence never ends.

Your past wins are not the finish line they are your launchpad.

If you want to lead in GCV:
Dream bigger. Act bolder. Inspire endlessly.

Comfort kills growth. Growth fuels the movement.
Your vision lifts your region, your team, and the global community.

Ask yourself:
Am I dreaming big enough for GCV? For the future we are building?

True GCV leaders never settle. They rise. They stretch.  
They surround themselves with warriors who think bigger, fight harder, and push further.

Let your vision outlive you. Share it. Teach it. Multiply it.
In GCV, the vision is bigger than the visionary.

Leadership isn’t for the comfortable  
It’s for the bold, the fearless, and the GCV Warriors who keep moving forward while everyone else stands still.
